basic_info.main_problem: 因为四个犯罪谜题中的最后一个not yet能解决而感到overwhelmed与挫败，这导致了失败感和沮丧。
basic_info.core_demands: I want to stop seeing myself as a failure and return to a normal state; these feelings have significantly affected my daily life and work performance, and I hope to get relief.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/have not能力

special_situations.event: 在尝试解四个犯罪谜题时，最后一个not yet能解决（前三个已成功）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能把所有题目都解出来，之前的成功就not算数，我就是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过听音乐、吸食大麻来分散注意以逃避失败感，暂时not再尝试该谜题
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not smart enough，I am a failure，所有努力都白费了

special_situations.event: 当反复想到那个not yet解决的谜题或参与类似的解谜活动时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次遇到类似难题，我一定会失败；失败意味着我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids or delays participating in similar challenges to reduce the possibility of failing again

special_situations.event: Difficulty concentrating at work; performance declines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果工作表现not好，就证明我整体能力not足、I am worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distances himself from friends and family; reduces others' evaluations and contact
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的工作也做not好，I am worthless

special_situations.event: Facing opportunities to communicate with friends or family and share troubles
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express distress to friends, I will burden them and they may look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 选择not分享、保持隔离以避免“麻烦”他人
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not该麻烦do not人，他们会被我拖累

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable and worthy of respect; hopes to maintain self-worth and confidence
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败后被看轻、被评判为without能，成为他人的负担
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being evaluated through distance and avoidance
用分散注意与Self-denial来控制Anxiety与羞耻
not向他人求助以保持表面安全感

object_relations.self_representation: 把自己视为失败者/负担者
object_relations.object_representation: Regarding others as people who may look down on oneself and be dragged down by oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to share troubles with family and friends or seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识认为亲友会被自己拖累、会看轻自己（Projection性解读）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 委婉拒绝分享，强调“我not该麻烦do not人”，语气平静但回避深入谈及他人支持

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about failure experiences or being asked to try a challenge again
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为一次失败等于整体without能，必须远离以免再次受挫
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自我贬低的措辞（如“I am not smart enough”），语气低落，降低交流与参与度

manifestations: 将一次not yet完成视为negate前三次成功，感觉“所有努力都白费”
Hard to gain meaning and value from achievements
主动与朋友和家人疏离，not分享感受
担心会“麻烦”他人而not求助

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains impulses originally wanting to express or act toward others or the environment, and does it to themselves instead, drawing the energy inward
manifestations: 有密友但选择not分享失败与沮丧
Pressing the need that could have been directed outward for support back onto myself, bearing it alone

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths，与“拒绝”对应
manifestations: 自我要求“我not该麻烦do not人”，把not打扰他人当成硬性规则
Evaluating oneself by the standard of 'only completing everything counts as success'

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对难度较高的谜题时，来访者通常会将一次失败灾难化、negate既往成功，并产生Self-denial与回避
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在同一系列的前三个谜题中，来访者成功解决并感到自豪与有能力，not yet出现Self-denial
exception_events.reason: not同理解：当时的自我对话是“我有能力、我擅长这个”；not同情境：题目与其能力匹配，投入度较高

positive_force: Multiple successful experiences on similar tasks (the first three puzzles)
愿意尝试not同的认知与行为方法（愿意进行行为实验）
Has a few close friends as potential support resources
Can clearly express inner experiences and is willing to seek counseling
negative_force: Thinking patterns of catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, and overgeneralization
Mental filtering: focuses only on one failure and ignores successes
Overly binding self-worth to a single outcome, seeking external validation
usewithout效的应对策略（音乐、吸食大麻）导致问题持续

target_behavior.behavior: 自我标签与Self-denial（如“I am a failure”“I am not smart enough”）
antecedent: 参与类似的解谜或挑战活动
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次失败等同于整体能力not足，存在非黑即白、过度概括与心理过滤的认知
target_behavior.function: In the short term maintains his self-explanatory framework and avoids trying again to escape the sense of failure
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood、Decreased drive、工作表现受损

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance与隔离（not与朋友家人分享困扰）
antecedent: When thinking of confiding in friends or entering social settings
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being looked down on or troubling others; fear of evaluation and shame
target_behavior.function: Escaping others' evaluations and potential negative feedback, maintaining a surface sense of security
target_behavior.consequence: 支持减少、Loneliness加重、情绪问题维持

target_behavior.behavior: Distracting attention with substances and music (smoking marijuana, listening to music)
target_behavior.core_reason: Seeks ways to quickly relieve negative emotions and feelings of failure
target_behavior.consequence: 问题not yet被解决，可能进一步影响睡眠、专注与工作表现

antecedent: 持续反复思考失败与挫败感
target_behavior.core_reason: 挫败与Anxiety驱动的生理与作息失调
target_behavior.consequence: Physical condition declined, attention and work performance further impaired
